name: Governance & ownership
definition: Records that establish the business entity, ownership, formal authority, governance structure, or major company decisions.
examples: articles or certificate of incorporation | shareholder or ownership register
use_when: Entity, ownership, formal authority, or governance action is the primary responsibility.

name: Finance, accounting & tax
definition: Accounting books, transaction evidence, banking, receivables and payables, expenses, reconciliations, financial reporting, tax, and financial-remittance records.
responsibility: Bookkeeping, cash, financial reporting, tax, and transaction evidence.
use_when: The record primarily evidences, records, reconciles, reports, pays, collects, or supports a financial/tax obligation.

name: Customers & revenue
definition: Records that define, develop, manage, or document customer relationships, commercial opportunities, sales commitments, and ongoing customer accounts.
responsibility: Sales and the ongoing customer relationship.
use_when: The commercial customer relationship is primary; specific execution belongs with Projects.

name: Vendors & procurement
definition: Records used to source, evaluate, select, order from, manage, and communicate with suppliers and service providers.
use_when: Choosing, ordering from, or managing a supplier is primary; transaction evidence normally belongs with Finance.

name: People & workforce
definition: Employment, contractor, role, compensation-administration, time, training, performance, and other workforce records about people working for or with the business.
use_when: The working relationship or workforce administration is primary; payroll accounting/remittance evidence normally belongs with Finance.

name: Projects, jobs & delivery
definition: Records that define, execute, change, approve, evidence, complete, or hand off specific customer work, projects, jobs, engagements, or deliverables.
responsibility: Delivery of the specific job, project, or engagement.
use_when: Execution or delivery of a defined job, project, engagement, or deliverable is primary.

name: Operations & procedures
definition: Recurring operating procedures, checklists, schedules, instructions, quality methods, and routine process records used to run the business consistently.
responsibility: The recurring process or operating method.
use_when: A repeatable operating method is primary; topic-specific notes/checklists stay with their actual subject.

name: Assets & facilities
definition: Records that identify, assign, operate, service, inspect, repair, warrant, or manage physical assets, equipment, vehicles, tools, premises, and facilities.
responsibility: The asset, equipment, vehicle, premises, or facility.
examples: asset register | vehicle or equipment record
use_when: Asset identity, custody, condition, operation, maintenance, warranty, inspection, or facilities management is primary.

name: Inventory & supplies
definition: Records used to identify, count, receive, store, issue, consume, reorder, adjust, or trace inventory, stock, materials, and recurring supplies.
responsibility: Stock availability, movement, and material control.
examples: SKU or item master | stock count
use_when: Stock or supply control is primary; supplier selection stays with Vendors and invoices stay with Finance.

name: Insurance, risk & incidents
definition: Insurance policies and certificates, claims, risk assessments, incident records, damage evidence, loss events, and other records primarily used to understand or manage business risk.
responsibility: Insurance, claims, risk response, loss prevention, and incident handling.
use_when: Insurance, claims, risk, or incident handling is primary unless formal compliance evidence is the main purpose.

name: Compliance, licences & safety
definition: Licences, permits, required certifications, regulated inspections, safety-program evidence, compliance records, and other material maintained primarily to demonstrate required permission or adherence.
responsibility: The licence, safety duty, regulatory requirement, or compliance evidence.
use_when: A legal, regulatory, licensing, safety, or professional requirement is the record’s main purpose.

name: Technology, access & data
definition: Records that define, operate, administer, secure, recover, or document business systems, software, accounts, access, data handling, and technology services.
responsibility: The system, account, access model, configuration, data process, backup, or technology service.
use_when: The system, account, access model, configuration, data process, backup, or technology service is primary.

name: Marketing & brand
definition: Brand standards, creative assets, campaigns, content, advertising, media, messaging, publication, and other records used to present and promote the business.
responsibility: The brand, campaign, content, public message, or marketing channel.
examples: brand guideline | logo or brand asset
use_when: Brand or marketing work is primary; customer commercial records and financial invoices stay with their natural responsibilities.

name: Strategy & planning
definition: Business plans, forecasts, priorities, market or internal research, roadmaps, strategic decisions, and records whose main purpose is choosing or directing future action.
responsibility: Future direction, priorities, and major initiatives.
examples: business plan | forecast used for planning
use_when: Forward-looking direction or planning is primary; books, delivery plans, and recurring procedures stay in operating categories.

name: Knowledge & continuity
definition: Operational lessons, durable decision context, reference material, handoff notes, and other records whose main purpose is preserving what the business knows so work can continue across people and time.
responsibility: Reusable know-how, decision context, and continuity across people or time.
use_when: Preserving reusable know-how or continuity is primary; do not use this as miscellaneous storage.
